title_sq: Ne Sauk, Shitet Shtepi 4 Kate Me Pamje Fantastike !!
description_sq: Ne Kodrat e Saukut, mbrapa Restorant Xibraku, ne super pozicion, shitet nje shpi kater kateshe. Shtepia shtrihet ne truall 97m² me gjurme ndertimi rreth 88 m² duke e bere siperfaqen e banimit ne te gjitha katet 320 m² te pajisur me certifikate pronesie. Ne katin zero organizohet ne nje hapesire e ndare ne dy ambjente qe mund te sherbej si per biznes ashtu dhe per banim (dy garsoniere) si dhe nje post parkimi, kati i pare eshte i ndare ne sallon bashke me ambjentin e gatimit, dy dhoma dhe nje tualet me dritare, kati i dyte eshte i organizuar ne sallon me vete dhe ambjenti i gatimit me vete si dhe nje tualet me dritare, dhe kati i trete eshte i organizuar ne dy dhoma gjumi ku seicila ka tualet me vete me dritare. Duhet theksuar qe kati i pare ka dhe nje verande prej 30 m2, kurse kati i dyte dhe i trete ka seicili nga nje ballkon ku te ofrohet nje pamje fantastike nga qyteti. Shtepia pozicionohet ne nje vendodhje perfekte qe te jep mundesine te nje pamje te lire dhe te mrekullueshme 360 grade, ajrin e paster qe ofrojne kodrat e Saukut si dhe qetesia, duke e bere nje eksperience mjaft te mire jetesen. Aksesohet shume lehte nga rruga kyesore. Prona disponon dokumentacion te rregullt.
title_en: In Sauk, a 4-storey house with a fantastic view is for sale!!
description_en: In Kodrat e Sauk, behind Xibraku Restaurant, in a great position, a four-story house is for sale. The house is spread over a plot of 97 m² with construction traces of about 88 m², making the living area on all floors 320 m², equipped with ownership certificates. On the ground floor, it is organized in a space divided into two areas that can be used for both business and residence (two studios) as well as a parking post, the first floor is divided into a living room with a kitchen area, two rooms and a bathroom with a window, the second floor is organized into a living room with its own cooking area and a toilet with a window, and the third floor is organized into two bedrooms, each of which has its own toilet with window. It should be noted that the first floor has a veranda of 30 m2, while the second and third floors each have a balcony offering a fantastic view of the city. The house is positioned in a perfect location that gives you the possibility of a free and wonderful 360-degree view, the clean air that the Sauk hills offer, as well as the tranquility, making life a very good experience. It is very easily accessible from the main road. The property has proper documentation.
